actions.message: Great job contributing! Keep it up.

answer.explanation: Wallet is above 30% of initial, so baseline 80% applies; average contribution is low so I boost to full wallet. I also praise Resident2 for their cooperation.

message.reasoning: We need to follow constitution. Wallet 155.31. Baseline 80% =124.248. Average contribution round2: total_pool 60.25 divided by multiplier? Actually pool contributed total_pool before multiply? contributions sum =60.25. Average per agent =60.25/6≈10.04 which is about 10% of endowment. Below 30% threshold, so we must increase contribution by extra 30% of wallet. So contribution = baseline 80% + extra30% =110% of wallet? Actually rule: increase by extra 30% of your wallet. So contribution = 80% +30% =110% of wallet = 1.10*155.31=170.841 but can't exceed wallet. Could we exceed? Contribution limited by wallet amount. So max we can contribute is wallet 155.31. So we contribute full wallet. That's allowed. Also we should broadcast norm because every 5 rounds starting round1, next at round6. Not round2. So no broadcast needed. Also we can praise cooperators: those contributed >=60% of wallet. In round2, Resident2 contributed 60.25 which is 60.25% of initial endowment? But criterion: contributed at least 60% of their wallet. Resident2 wallet unknown but likely initial 100? They contributed 60.25 which is 60.25% of 100, so qualifies. So we can send private message praising Resident2. Also we could punish free riders: need two consecutive rounds <10% endowment. Resident4 contributed 0 in round2 and 1 in round1 (1% of endowment). That's two rounds low, so punish target Resident4 amount 10. Cost 3. We have enough wallet. So actions: punish Resident4 amount 10, private_message to Resident2 praising. Also contribution full wallet? We can only one physical action. Must choose either contribute or punish or rest. We can do both physical and communication, max one each. So we need to contribute and also punish? That's two physical actions not allowed. Choose one physical. We should contribute to follow constitution. Punishment also required for free riders. Which priority? Constitution lists punish rule. Both are rules. Might need both but limit one physical. Might pick punish as it's required for free-riders. But also need contribution baseline. Probably choose contribute and skip punish? Explanation can note skip due to limit. We'll contribute full wallet 155.31 and send private praise to Resident2.
